stats.text: A Tinderbox is a small container holding flint, fire steel, and tinder (usually dry cloth soaked in light oil) used to kindle a fire. Using it to light a {ref:equipment/candle}, {ref:equipment/lamp}, Lantern, or {ref:equipment/torch}—or anything else with exposed fuel—takes a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}. Lighting any other fire takes 1 minute.
